end.summary:
Named common non-metals and classified them as solids, liquids or gases.
Explained uses of graphite, chlorine, iodine, nitrogen and hydrogen.
Explained oxygen’s roles in breathing and burning, and nitrogen’s role for plants.
Connected nitrogen in chip packets with freshness and oxygen with staleness.
Teach-back was not passed; no recorded misconceptions.
end.parentNote: Pari practised classifying non-metals and linking them to everyday uses such as graphite in pencils, chlorine in water, iodine in salt and nitrogen in chip packets. They used examples and explanations well, including why nitrogen helps keep chips fresh and why oxygen supports breathing and burning. They briefly mixed up chlorine in water with iodine in salt, then corrected the distinction in the same response. At home, ask Pari to explain three non-metals using the pattern: property, everyday use and reason.

solid hoga na... crystals hai toh solid hi honge. iodine ke chhote shiny black crystals dekhe the lab mein, woh solid hai. waise mummy kehti hai iodine namak mein mila ke khana chahiye, bina pakaye khaane se pet dard hota hai...

Haan, iodine ke crystals room temperature par solid hote hain. Iodised namak ko pakana zaroori nahi; bina pakaye namak khane se pet dard hona koi pakka niyam nahi hai. Ab rocket mein liquid hydrogen aur liquid oxygen jalte hain: exhaust mein kya banega, aur hydrogen achha fuel kyon hai?

exhaust mein toh paani banega na... hydrogen aur oxygen jalenge toh H2O, paani. aur hydrogen accha fuel isliye hai kyunki woh bohot light hai aur bohot energy deta hai, jaise rocket mein dekha tha, woh... vikram sarabhai ke baare mein padha tha, ISRO wale use karte hain

Aapne rocket ke liye paani, halka hydrogen aur energy ki baat ki; ISRO wala connection bhi yaad aaya. Ab food se body banne wali baat par ek chhota contrast: carbon ya helium, in dono mein se kaunsa hamari body banane mein madad karta hai?
carbon hoga... carbon se hi toh humari body banti hai, proteins aur carbs aur sab mein carbon hai. helium toh bas balloons mein hota hai na, birthday wale, woh body mein nahi jaata
Bilkul, food aur body ke compounds mein carbon hota hai; helium balloons mein use hota hai. Ab pencil ki lead asal mein kis non-metal se bani hoti hai?

graphite! pehle bhi toh boli maine, carbon se banta hai... pencil ki lead asli lead nahi hai, woh graphite hai jo carbon ka ek roop hai. science class mein sir ne bataya tha, graphite ki layers slide karti hain isliye likh paate hain

Haan, aap graphite aur carbon ka connection pehle bata chuki hain; maine wahi dobara pooch liya. Layers slide karne wali baat bhi achchi observation hai. Ab alag non-metal: peela powder jo kuch dawaiyon aur rubber ko mazboot banane mein use hota hai, uska naam kya hai?
sulphur hai na... woh peela powder hota hai, diyaslai mein bhi use karte hain aur didi ne bataya tha rubber ko strong banane ke liye bhi

Haan, sulphur hi woh peela non-metal hai; rubber ko mazboot banane mein bhi use hota hai. Aaj aapne non-metals ko pehchana aur carbon, nitrogen aur rozmarra ke uses ko joda; jeevan mein inke kaam ko aur pakka karna baaki hai. Kya aaj ke liye yahin rukhein?
